evidence.quote:
The article's current title does not fully reflect its focus on hydrogen projects, and its abstract lacks
emphasis on the hydrogen sector. A revised title, such as “Mapping Leadership and
Communities in EU-funded Hydrogen Research Through Network Analysis”, will better align
with the paper's subject matter and objectives. Additionally, the abstract should be refined to
highlight the centrality of hydrogen research in the analysis.

Your feedback helped us improve the structure and clarity of the article. The revised
manuscript (to be submitted shortly) reflects your suggestions and incorporates recent
literature. Key changes include a revised title and abstract (updated to better reflect the
contents of the paper) and an expanded introduction chapter to provide a broader overview
of hydrogen valleys. This has made the introduction significantly longer—hopefully not
excessively so.
